title: Give advice
description: Practise polite advice with should and If I were you.

items.targetText: If I were you, I would call the hotel first.

items.prompt: Give advice to a friend who is nervous about travelling alone.
items.promptIt: Dai un consiglio a un amico che è nervoso per un viaggio da solo.
items.exampleAnswer: You should start with a short trip. If I were you, I would book a hotel near the station.
items.hint: Use should and If I were you
